rules.text: Cash flow amounts are stored signed: inflows (Deposit, SIP, Lump Sum, Interest Credit, Tax Refund, Dividend Reinvestment) are positive; outflows (Withdrawal, Redemption) are negative. Net cash flow = SUM(amount). For XIRR calculation only, apply the investor's-pocket transform (use -amount).
When presenting total withdrawal amount (a magnitude), show as a positive number using -SUM(amount) or SUM(ABS(amount)) over that type.

XIRR is the annualised return computed from irregular cash flows. It is the primary performance KPI. For XIRR series, apply investor's-pocket transform (use -amount). Guardrails: XIRR > 25% must trigger data quality investigation; XIRR < -50% flagged as suspect; if XIRR cannot be computed (no cash flows, all same-signed) return null. Reasonable XIRR ranges by asset class: Equity (Long Term) 10–18% (cap 25%), Debt 5–9% (cap 15%), Hybrid 8–14% (cap 20%), ELSS/Tax-saving 10–18% (cap 25%).

citations.quote: XIRR is the annualised return of an investment computed from irregular cash flows (SIP contributions, lump sum investments, withdrawals, and the current portfolio value as a terminal cash flow). It is the primary performance KPI for goal and portfolio return analysis.

rules.text: Returns percentage (returns_pct) = (current_value - cost) / cost × 100 stored in portfolio_holding.returns_pct. Guardrails: returns_pct > 200% on a holding < 1 year old flagged; returns_pct negative while current_value > cost flagged; cost = 0 or NULL excluded.
For "average return", use equal-weighted AVG(returns_pct) at per-investor-first grain. For "portfolio / overall / value-weighted return", weight by current_value or cost.

Portfolio health scores (goal_match_pct, risk_score, liquidity_score, diversification_score) are on a 0-100 scale. Thresholds: goal_match_pct ≥ 80% On track, 60-79% Needs attention, <60% At risk; risk_score 0-40 Low risk, 41-70 Moderate risk, 71-100 High risk; liquidity_score ≥ 70 Adequate liquidity; diversification_score ≥ 70 Well diversified.

Goal progress achievement_pct = (current_value / target_amount) × 100 stored as progress_pct in ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001. If achievement_pct < 50% and goal target_date within 2 years → flag as high-priority advisory case.

Allocation drift = |current_allocation_pct - target_allocation_pct| in rebalancing_action. If drift > 10 percentage points for any sector → trigger rebalancing recommendation. Drift within 2% is within normal market fluctuation and should not trigger an action.

Conservative investors must not hold > 40% equity. Aggressive investors: single-sector cap at 40%; equity cap at 80%. Conservative investors: any single sector allocation > 30% flagged for compliance review. Moderate investors: single-sector cap > 40%. Aggressive investors: single-sector cap > 50%.
ELSS has 3-year lock-in; PPF has 15-year lock-in. Do not recommend redemption within lock-in period. ELSS and PPF are tax-saving instruments under Section 80C. Flag when recommending alternatives.

Allocation concentration for an investor = the largest single-sector share = MAX(allocation_pct) over that investor's rows in ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001. A cohort's "average allocation concentration" = per-investor MAX, then AVG across investors.

Risk pressure score = RS + (100 − LS) + (100 − DS) where RS=risk_score, LS=liquidity_score, DS=diversification_score from ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001. Scale 0-300. NULL if any health score is NULL → investor excluded.

Quantitative burden index = normalized 0–100 index of {SHORT, −GAIN, −NCF, C1} where SHORT = SUM(shortfall), GAIN = SUM(current_value − cost), NCF = SUM(amount) over period, C1 = risk_pressure_score. Formula: 100 × mean( S̃HORT , (1−G̃AIN) , (1−ÑCF) , C̃1 ) with min-max normalization per component over population. Threshold for critical burden cohort: index > 65 (≈ top ~3%).

Transaction rebalance index = normalized 0–100 index of {NCF, REB, SCENΔsum} where NCF = SUM(amount), REB = SUM(amount) from rebalancing_action, SCENΔsum = SUM(new_allocation_pct − current_allocation_pct) from scenario_rebalancing. Formula: 100 × mean( ÑCF , R̃EB , S̃CENΔsum ).

Temporal pressure index = normalized 0–100 index of {NCF(period), REB, −AVGSHORT, SCENΔsum} where NCF window = the year the question states, AVGSHORT = AVG(shortfall). Formula: 100 × mean( ÑCF(period) , R̃EB , (1−ÃVGSHORT) , S̃CENΔsum ).
Combined gain and net cash flow = GAIN + NCF where GAIN = SUM(current_value − cost) from portfolio_holding, NCF = SUM(amount) from cash_flow. Units INR.
Combined net cash flow and rebalancing amount = NCF + REB where NCF = SUM(amount) from cash_flow, REB = SUM(amount) from rebalancing_action. Units INR.
Combined holding value and shortfall = HVAL + SHORT where HVAL = SUM(current_value) from portfolio_holding, SHORT = SUM(shortfall) from investment_goal. Units INR.

When grouping by investor attribute (risk_tolerance, time_horizon, segment, category, sector_focus), every averaged metric must be computed per-investor-first (aggregate to one row per investor in a CTE, then AVG across investors).
Do not join a table the question does not reference. When combining optional child metrics, use LEFT JOIN from INVESTOR_PROFILE (one row per investor) so no cohort member is dropped.
Any ORDER BY <score> LIMIT k where score can tie must add a deterministic secondary key (e.g., entity_id ASC) for stable results.
For "highest/lowest" rankings on scores that can be NULL, add WHERE X IS NOT NULL so missing rows are not returned as bottom.
For proportion / "share of investors" denominators, use the full cohort as denominator. A missing (NULL) metric counts as not meeting the threshold and is not removed from the denominator.

Fields that must never be aggregated: investor_id, holding_id, goal_id, cash_flow_id, rebalance_id, portfolio_health_id, purchase_date, risk_tolerance, segment, investment_goal, action, investment_type, sector, category, type. Use only for GROUP BY, COUNT(DISTINCT), or JOIN.

Aggregation rules: cost and current_value SUM per investor; returns_pct AVG (equal-weighted) or weighted AVG; dividends and taxes_paid SUM per investor; amount SUM per type; goal_match_pct AVG per investor (across goals); risk_score, liquidity_score, diversification_score AVG across investors for cohort; allocation_pct SUM only within a single investor (must = 100%); AVG across investors for sector exposure.

XIRR aggregation: Never pool all investors' cash flows into a single XIRR calculation. Compute XIRR per investor_id, then report as distribution (MIN, P25, MEDIAN, P75, MAX). For cohort XIRR, compute individual XIRRs, then present distribution.

Data quality check: purchase_date must not be in the future and must not predate 1990-01-01; cost must be > 0 and not NULL; current_value must be ≥ 0; investor_id referential integrity; duplicate cash flow transactions must be deduplicated before XIRR.

Market cap segments: Large Cap > ₹20,000 Cr, Mid Cap ₹5,000–20,000 Cr, Small Cap < ₹5,000 Cr. Segment vs. investment type mismatch: market cap segments apply only to equity instruments; flag if category = 'Debt'.
Emergency Fund goal must be near-liquid (Debt/liquid funds). Flag if equity allocation > 10%.
Conservative investor equity overweight: risk_tolerance = 'Conservative' and total equity allocation > 40% → Flag as suitability breach.
High-risk product for Conservative investor: category = 'Equity' and segment = 'Small Cap' held by risk_tolerance = 'Conservative' investor → Flag as unsuitable.
Quantitative burden index threshold for critical burden cohort: index > 65 (≈ top ~3%).
Goal progress achievement_pct is stored as progress_pct in ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001.
Allocation drift > 10 percentage points triggers a rebalancing recommendation. Drift within 2% is within normal market fluctuation and should not trigger an action.

For Conservative investors, any single sector allocation > 30% must be flagged for compliance review. For Moderate investors, single-sector cap is > 40%. For Aggressive investors, single-sector cap is > 50%.
ELSS and PPF are tax-saving instruments under Section 80C. Flag when recommending alternatives.
Goal-based allocation: Retirement/Wealth Creation goals → higher equity for long horizons; Emergency Fund → near 100% liquid/debt.
Reasonable XIRR ranges by asset class: Equity (Long Term) 10–18% (plausibility cap 25%), Debt 5–9% (cap 15%), Hybrid 8–14% (cap 20%), ELSS/Tax-saving 10–18% (cap 25%).
